title: Core: FLA round-trip serialization (bitmap + sound assets)
description: Unit tests for saveFla/loadFla round-trip with binary assets. Create a FlashDocument with a BitmapItem (base64 PNG data URI) and a SoundItem (base64 MP3 data URI). saveFla() to bytes, loadFla(bytes) back, verify the dataUri fields are restored correctly. Tests in packages/core/src/fla/__tests__/roundtrip-assets.test.ts. Import saveFla, loadFla from @flash/core/fla/zip.
